methodology.coverage: Every lesson received an identifying early/title-window inspection and a separate mid-content perceptual frame inspection.
methodology.titleMethod: Direct title-card transcription where present; OCR assisted locating Fernando/Tatiana lower thirds, followed by reconciliation against the visible card and catalog title.
methodology.contentMethod: One additional mid-content frame per lesson was inspected for dance style, instructor/course family, and obvious asset swaps.
methodology.duplicateMethod: Equal-size candidates were SHA-256 checked; the sole Salsa Masterclass equal-size pair is byte-identical.
methodology.limitation: This is a bounded perceptual audit, not an end-to-end viewing of every minute. A null observedTitle means no reliable on-video title card was seen in the inspected window; it is not treated as proof of a wrong asset.
